digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure / CI gate / code-review criterion
propositions: Upper-bound wall-clock assertions in tests cause CI flakiness under runner contention and must be detected and blocked in code review
Detector identifies unescaped upper-bound timing asserts via regex and allows two escape patterns: hang-guard marker comment and skipif-CI perf-lane guard
Two migration sites replace upper-bound asserts with counting-proxy spies: test_config_perf spies cache miss-path; test_enrich_drain counts pending enrichment calls
Remaining nine in-scope upper-bound asserts are marked with reasoned hang-guard comments explaining why timing bounds are necessary
Detector unit tests verify fire cases, both escape patterns, bare benchmark marker rejection, lower-bound exclusion, and self-exclusion via EXCLUDED_FILES idiom
